race.name: Human
race.physicalDescription: Adaptable people found across nearly every region, with highly varied appearances, cultures, and traditions.

traits: Keeps meticulous journals yet replaces every person's name with an increasingly confusing nickname.
Grandly theatrical in public, quiet and observant in private, and terrified of being considered ordinary.

talents:
Duelist — +1 when fighting a single visible opponent without nearby interference.
Tracker — +2 when following a trail left by a known creature.
statusEffects: Distracted — -1 to the next Perception-based action.
equipment: Epic light armor — Remarkable weightless protection crafted through rare techniques.
Heavy repeating crossbow — A bulky mechanism capable of rapid shots before reloading.
inventory: Local map — A practical but imperfect map of the surrounding region.
Lantern and oil — A hooded lantern with enough oil for several hours.
Lockpicking kit — Small tools for manipulating ordinary mechanical locks.
